decision: Make the duration-bound calibration CLI the only operational resource-evidence entrypoint and fail closed when the legacy harness is executed directly.

reviews.reason: A second executable path with a 1000ms default can emit post-workload/idle-contaminated evidence even when the duration-bound implementation is correct.

reviews.preferred: disable legacy execution rather than silently redirect inside a cyclic module graph
reviews.reason: Fail-closed behavior makes accidental use visible and avoids an import cycle between the low-level harness and the duration-bound CLI.

reviews.preferred: retain low-level harness exports for tests/composition, remove only operational authority
reviews.reason: This adds no qrexec calls, worker CPU, VM memory, or production mission mutations and minimizes regression surface.

rejected.failure: allows unsafe fixed-interval evidence to remain operational

rejected.approach: make the harness import the duration-bound CLI
rejected.failure: creates or risks a circular dependency because the duration-bound CLI imports harness runtime builders

rejected.approach: silently clamp 1000ms to a safe interval
rejected.failure: hides operator configuration errors instead of failing closed

requirements: direct legacy execution exits non-zero and emits no calibration evidence
hosted and local distributed-fault shards include the authority test
full npm check/test include duration-bound and authority suites

lesson: A correct replacement path is insufficient while an older executable path can still produce weaker evidence; operational authority must be unique and test-enforced.
